title: Time Value of Money (TVM) - computing PMT (for the CFA Level 1 exam)
description:
Time Value of Money (TVM) - computing PMT (for the CFA Level 1 exam) explores using the TVM worksheet on the Texas Instruments BA II Plus calculator to solve for the size of equal future withdrawals.

For a comprehensive directory of all videos featured on this channel, please visit the channel companion website: www.letmeexplain.eu
